themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents performing research tasks, including autonomous agents, agent layers, and agentic operations.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content related to AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, including their security implications.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing a variety of AI tools used for research purposes, encompassing broad applications and comparisons.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the use and impact of AI chatbots in various research contexts, including their potential for misinformation and influencing opinions.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is applied to the fields of UI/UX design, including AI-generated interfaces and design system impacts.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Content related to AI's role in product development, market analysis, and the acceleration of research and development for new products.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discussions around AI's application in evaluating the usability of systems and products, and the human element in these processes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles focused on AI's ability to condense information from various sources, such as transcripts and research findings.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content discussing the use of AI-generated personas or data to simulate user behavior in research and product testing.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles examining how AI influences employment, job creation, and the skills required in the modern workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
